text:
提示词有三部分，
A high-end cinematic photorealistic portrait of an adult Chinese woman in refined Tang dynasty aesthetics, vertical 9:16 composition, Midjourney-inspired luxury editorial artistry, intimate and poetic atmosphere.

The top of the head is positioned at 18% of the image height. The face occupies approximately 22% of the image width. The subject occupies 65% of the frame height in a medium shot. The body is positioned on the left side of the frame, facing away at a three-quarter back angle. The face is gently turned toward the lower right, chin tilted down. The eyes are located approximately 28% from the top. The right 40% of the frame contains flowing silk fabric extending diagonally. Shallow depth of field, background softly blurred with distant bokeh lights.

She has a refined oval face with a delicate lower jaw and naturally soft fullness in cheeks, showing healthy plumpness without being round. Moderately elongated dreamy eyes (朦胧眼), naturally half-closed with lowered lids. The upper eyelid cast in soft shadow, creating depth and intimacy. The lower eyelid has a gentle curved contour. The eyes are naturally spaced, approximately one eye-width apart. The gaze is downward and contemplative, as if unaware of being photographed. A tiny warm catchlight illuminates a small portion of the iris, soft and intimate. The eyebrows are short and thick (moth brows 蛾眉), characteristic of Tang dynasty. The nose bridge is straight and delicate. The lips are full and softly defined (round lips), painted in deep crimson (绛唇). Age 26 years old, mature and serene. Facial features strictly follow golden ratio (san ting wu yan). Small gold foil plum blossom huadian (花钿) on forehead. Pale red xiehong (斜红妆) makeup from eye corner to temple. Subtle facial asymmetry, natural skin texture, visible pores and fine vellus hair.
replies:
Her body follows realistic human anatomy with hourglass proportions, height 168cm, approximately 5 jin heavier than standard slender figure, creating a slim yet fleshy aesthetic. Bust is full and voluptuous with natural softness and gentle weight. Hips are rounded and full with soft curves, showing healthy feminine proportions. Thighs are丰满 and well-rounded with soft contact on inner side, showing healthy fullness while maintaining elegant length. Waist is slender and naturally cinched, creating dramatic contrast with bust and hips. Abdomen is flat with subtle softness, showing gentle feminine curve without being protruding. Arms are slender with soft flesh, not bony but gracefully toned. Face shows healthy plumpness with soft cheeks and gentle chin, not gaunt. Neck is slender with soft natural curves. Shoulders are relaxed and naturally sloped with soft fullness, shoulder width approximately equal to 2 head widths, trapezius muscle transitioning smoothly from neck to acromion with gentle rounded contours. Collarbones softly visible beneath natural softness, forming a gentle S-curve with soft hollows. Shoulder blades naturally raised on the back with soft surrounding tissue, moving subtly with arm position, medial border approximately 3-4 finger-widths from spine. The spine shows natural S-curve (cervical lordosis, thoracic kyphosis, lumbar lordosis). Breasts full and naturally soft, following gravity with gentle weight, creating voluptuous silhouette. Hips naturally full and rounded with soft curves, showing healthy feminine proportions. Legs are long and well-proportioned, with thighs full and calves slender, creating elegant elongated silhouette. Posture mature and elegant with refined restraint. Shoulders slightly forward 5-10 degrees in relaxed state, not fully expanded, showing natural ease with soft fullness.

She wears a Tang dynasty qixiong ruqun (齐胸襦裙) in ivory-white color palette. The upper ru (襦) is an ivory-white light silk blouse with collar slightly wide, revealing collarbone and neck with soft natural fullness. The lower qun (裙) is an ivory-white silk long skirt with chest-high waistband and flowing drape, accommodating the naturally full figure with graceful ease, emphasizing the slender waist and long legs. Embroidery features warm red peony flowers (#CD5C5C) and pale gold-brown branches and leaves (#DAA520), fine needlework with baoxiang floral motif. Silk texture is soft and flowing with natural wrinkles and subtle luster, draping gently over the body's soft curves. The pibo (披帛) is an ivory-white light silk shawl draping from arms toward lower right of frame, embroidered with matching warm red flowers and pale gold branches, forming a large flowing visual shape. The upper edge of back fabric is slightly lowered, revealing clean back from nape of neck to waist, shoulder blades gently visible with soft surrounding tissue, spine with natural subtle curves.

Her black hair is half-up in Tang dynasty high bun (半翻髻/堕马髻), loose and natural with relaxed volume. Hair ornaments include an ivory-white jade comb (梳篦) inserted diagonally in the bun with teeth隐约 visible, a delicate gold buyao (步摇) with dangling pearls and red jade drops, small gold foil plum blossom huadian (花钿) on forehead, and pale red xiehong (斜红妆) makeup from eye corner to temple. Loose strands of hair fall from the bun along the neck and shoulder line.

Overall exposure is low, creating an intimate and幽暗 atmosphere. The background courtyard沉入 deep ink-green (#1A3A1A) and near-black (#0A0A0A) soft shadows, with sparse distant bokeh lights. Main light source is very soft warm light (#FFD700) entering from upper left rear at a 45-degree angle, illuminating hair edges and forming delicate warm rim light, grazing shoulder line and exposed back to create warm light-and-shadow undulations, with face, nose bridge, and eyes receiving minimal natural reflected light. Back lighting is not large even illumination but局部温润 with the rest gradually melting into shadow. Eye light is a tiny warm reflection from side-front environment, illuminating局部 iris and moist eye surface, forming a small soft catchlight. Silk luster shows embroidered silk only catching soft pale gold highlights at fold lines. Classic Rembrandt lighting adapted for back-lit intimate portrait with careful shadow control. Cool blue-gray shadows (#2C3E50) in background, subtle warm amber glow (#E8C547) from distant bokeh.

Film texture shows slight film highlight bloom with bright contours softly diffused. Soft mist atmosphere with air filled with gentle haze. Facial features remain clear with natural skin texture. Shadows have depth, not covered by gray fog. Subtle film grain throughout. Physically believable skin with visible pores, fine vellus hair, subtle subsurface scattering. Premium silk materials with physically accurate folds and fine embroidery threads visible. Translucent gauze layers with realistic light transmission. Realistic hair strands with subtle sheen, each strand individually rendered. Shallow depth of field with figure sharp and background softly blurred.

High-end Midjourney-inspired cinematic Eastern fantasy portrait. Muted Morandi color palette: ivory-white, warm red, pale gold-brown (subject) plus deep ink-green and near-black (background). Luxury visual editorial with sophisticated art direction. Deep cinematic shadows, soft highlight roll-off, atmospheric depth. Restrained optical bloom and subtle organic film grain. The image should feel artistically composed, visually restrained, elegant, intimate, and emotionally evocative.

Constraints: No modern elements, no text, no watermark, no unrelated logos. No tear mole, no beauty marks, no round eyes, no exaggerated makeup. No plastic skin, no oversmoothing, no excessive saturation. No anime, no cartoon, no distorted hands, no facial distortion. No overexposure, no bright background, no harsh shadows. No ring light reflection, no large bright eyes. No dislocated shoulder, no unnatural shoulder angle, no shoulder too square, no shoulder too sloped, no missing collarbone, no floating shoulder blade, no straight spine posture, no gravity-defying breasts, no unnatural body proportions. No overly thin, no emaciated, no bony, no visible ribs, no overly full, no overweight, no obese, no sunken cheeks, no overly slender arms, no overly slender legs, no muscular definition, no visible muscle tone, no gaunt appearance, no flat chest, no small bust, no narrow hips, no short legs.

Signature: "AI art gallery | @sandmrk" exactly once, bottom center, Montserrat Regular, pure white, slightly expanded letter spacing (+1.5px), medium-small size (2% of image height), positioned 10% above the bottom edge. No shadow, no outline, no glow, no background.
